svg.title: Studio schedule: give each session its own detail line
svg.desc: Only three detail-line baselines move 40 layout units upward, from y525,665,805 to y485,625,765. Title baselines remain at y455,595,735. This makes title-to-detail intervals shorter than detail-to-next-title intervals. All text, titles, type styles, colors, photograph/crop, paper and lighting stay fixed. Original fictional schedule.
